title: Rate Limiting and Concurrency
snippet:
While there are no rate limits on the number of requests you can make per minute, there are concurrency limits based on your subscription plan:
- Free Account: Maximum of 1 concurrent request.
- Starter Plan: Maximum of 5 concurrent requests.
- Basic Plan: Maximum of 10 concurrent requests.
- Pro Plan: Maximum of 20 concurrent requests.
- Business Plan: Maximum of 40 concurrent requests.
To check your current concurrency limits:
- Log in to your HarvestAPI account.
- Navigate to your [Subscription Page](https://harvestapi.io/admin/subscription).
- Review your plan details to see your concurrency limits.

title: Harvest Pricing 2026 explained (+ flat-rate alternative & migration)
snippet:
**Harvest pricing 2026 now starts with a free pla**n (0$) for one person and two projects, and then includes** two paid plans: Teams – $9 per user per month (billed annually, 11$ billed monthly) and the Enterprise plan from $14 per user per month (billed annually, $17.50 monthly).** After Bending Spoons acquired it in July 2025, **pricing changed from a flat per-seat rate to two paid plans** (Teams and Enterprise) charged per seat, plus a custom Enterprise Plus.

- **Harvest now starts with a free plan ($0)** for one person and two projects,** then Teams at $9 per user per month and Enterprise at $14 per user per month** (billed annually; $11 and $17.50 monthly).

| **Harvest pricing 2026** | **Harvest paid plans pre- Bending Spoons acquisition in 2025** |
|---|---|
| - **Free**: $0 (one person, two projects) - **Teams:** $9 per user per month, billed annually - **Enterprise:** $14 per user per month (billed annually) *Flex requires additional usage fees.* | - **Free**: $0 (one person, two projects) - **Pro plan**: $11 per seat per month, billed annually - **Premium plan**: $14 per seat per month, billed annually *Flat per-seat rate, no usage fees.* |

| Plan | Annual billing (per seat/mo) | Monthly plan (per seat/mo) | Includes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Free | $0 | $0 | One individual: 1 seat, 2 projects |
| Teams | $9 ($108/seat/yr) | $11 | Teams that track, report, and invoice |
| Enterprise | $14 ($168/seat/yr) | $17.50 | Adds profitability, approvals, SSO, activity log |
| Enterprise Plus | Custom | Custom | Tailored integrations, white labeling, assisted migration |

Harvest offers a free plan (1 seat, 2 projects, basic time tracking, invoicing, and expense tracking), and two paid plans. Teams costs $9 per seat per month, and Enterprise is $14 per seat per month, both on annual billing (month-to-month is $11 and $17.50, respectively).

Harvest’s free plan lacks unlimited seats (it includes only one seat) and unlimited projects. Free Harvest alternatives like TimeCamp offer unlimited users, while Clockify and Toggl support teams of up to 5 users.

title: Is there a free version of Harvest?
snippet:
# Is there a free version of Harvest?
Harvest does have a free version, and it is available for anyone to use, though it does have some limitations.
When you first sign up for a Harvest account, you get a [free trial](https://www.getharvest.com/signup) that is fully featured—that is, it’s the same as it would be if you were paying for the account. This is different from the free *plan*, which you’re welcome to use as long as you’d like and which has some limitations.
## Do I have to take action to use the free plan?
Yes. When your trial ends, you'll need to choose to switch to the free version or upgrade to a paid account; if you don't take either action, your trial will expire and you won't have access to it until you do choose one of those options.
## How is the free plan different from a paid subscription?
Here are the limitations of the free version:
- You can have only *1 active person* in the account. Archived people don't count toward this limit.
- You’re limited to* 2 active projects.* Archived projects don’t count toward this limit.
- You *can’t* upload a company logo.
- You *can’t* attach files to invoices or estimates.
- You *can’t* integrate with QuickBooks Online or import projects and people from Asana.
- You *can’t* import data.
- *You can’t send invoices via email or export them as PDFs* without connecting Stripe for payments*.* This means that without connecting Stripe, invoices cannot be sent directly from Harvest on the Free plan.

To switch your *free trial* to the free plan:
1. Go to **Settings**.
2. In the **Billing** tab (left sidebar), click **Upgrade plan**.
3. Click **Switch to free** below the paid plan options.
4. Scroll to the bottom of the page and click the **Switch to free plan** to confirm.
- If you’ve enabled sample data in your trial account, any sample items will be removed when you make the switch.
- The switch to the free plan happens immediately, even if there is time remaining in your trial period.
